specs.title: Allowable release (cfs) can be set, then fully CLEARED via select-all + delete
proposing then removing an outlet, then reloading, shows NO outlet (local persistence)

$comment: CAPTURED FROM A REAL `npx playwright test --reporter=json` RUN (2026-08-08).
Only the bulky per-result payloads (stdout, errors, attachments) were dropped;
every structural fact the gate depends on is exactly as Playwright emitted it:
· config.rootDir is the ABSOLUTE testDir, and spec.file is relative to IT;
· the top-level suite of each file has title === file, and must be skipped or
the filename appears twice in the id.
B266086: the first cut of collectCases() was written against a fixture somebody
invented and got BOTH of those wrong, so every id it produced missed the ledger.
A fixture you invented can only confirm what you already believed. This one is real.
